ModMetaData.name: Rim Colony Transfer
ModMetaData.author: Harry Leach
ModMetaData.description:
Move an established colony into a brand-new world. Exports your colonists, their buildings and the settings that make the base work into an exchange file, then rebuilds it all on a fresh map in another save.
Buildings travel as Sketches — the same system the game uses for monument quests — so they carry no load IDs and cannot collide with anything in the destination save. Complexes are detected and placed independently, so a base split across a river doesn't need matching terrain to land on.
Both saves must run the same mod list; defs resolve by name.
